args.inputs: Actual accessible materials, tools and reference standards, if any can be found through physical investigation. No body dimensions, map coordinates, stock counts or assumed unit sizes qualify as calibration.
args.costs: Unknown. Declare necessary materials, study, effort, time and uncertainty. Investigation must not silently create, consume or reserve resources.
args.effects: Enable a real investigation or fabrication process with traceable evidence and honest uncertainty. candidates.function: Build a small open raised rack of 2 wood supports and 3 crosspieces that holds separated whole food off the soil; load and unload it, inspect it, compare stored roots with a carrie
Build a hand-lashed low A-frame thatched shelter for one reclining person from rods, binding, dry stems and bedding; inspect, resume, repair, dismantle or cancel it.
Nondestructively examine one accessible specimen (own item, loose ground item or one unit in place in a source): inspect records qualitative traits; measure reads one property with
Investigate one accessible candidate as a length reference; with a real calibrated source, transfer its length to a whole rigid carrier end to end and verify it.

execution.progress: build: an inspection round, then paid rounds that persist across interruption; repair and dismantle likewise; inspect takes one round.

details.costs: Study 4 rounds. Every paid round is 1 energy. build: x, y in reach, orientation (open end faces local -y), materials as own items with role rod, binding, thatch or bedding; a measured shortfall is refused at no cost. Round 1 inspects site and items; a failure reserves nothing. Then 9 rounds: legs, ridge and rails, battens twice, covering four times, bedding with final inspection. build naming the shelter resumes. inspect (anyone, site or shelter): 1 round. repair: replacements for defects, a round per metre of binding or 0.05 m3 of covering or bedding. dismantle (empty): 2 rounds. cancel: free. Gathering and travel are extra.
details.effects: Recipe: 20 rigid wood rods (diameter 0.04 m at 0.01 m precision; legs 0.82 m, others 0.9 m long), at least 30 m of strand (vine 3 m, reed 1.8 m a unit), 0.26 m3 of dry thin-stem covering and 0.1 m3 of dry bedding, volumes from mass, water share (dry at most 0.4) and the stem law; dry grass has none. Inputs become one shelter, 1.6 x 0.8 m under a 0.6 m ridge. Complete only after the final inspection. Occupant: one body wholly on the floor that came in by the open end; a second body voids protection. Rated to rain 5 mm/h (index 1 brings 0.033 mm/h) and wind 5 m/s (index 1 read as 5 m/s): rain on the body x(1 - 0.8 x cover), wind chill x(1 - 0.5 x cover x shelter not facing the wind with its open end), dry bedding halves the ground share (0.25) of cooling; air temperature unchanged. Covering holds rain up to its dry mass, leaks through gaps, dries. Strands and covering wear 0.001 a round, 0.002 in rain or wind; below 0.75 gaps open, below 0.5 lashings fail and the frame collapses. Cancel returns unbuilt inputs once; death stops the work and drops them where the person died; built parts stay until dismantled, returned with condition and water. No reward or refund.

execution.progress: Atomic: each inspect or measure is one paid round that commits when it completes; nothing is reserved, paused or resumed.

details.costs: Study 2 rounds, 0.2 energy each. inspect or measure: 1 round, 0.2 energy; target in reach; specimen is a unit number (default 1). measure: one property; length or diameter needs tools naming a serviceable item with a verified length calibration record, mass a calibrated balance with a verified tare, volume method cylinder and your current length and diameter readings of that unit; tool readings need light; every value needs a separated whole plain unit. Every check precedes payment: a refused request costs nothing. Travel and other specimens or properties are separate actions.
details.effects: A personal record and event: target, unit, method, tool and calibration provenance, value, units, resolution, uncertainty, conditions, scope and limits. inspect: form, hand feel, visible dryness, damage, wear, treatment, wholeness; metric values unavailable without a calibrated reference (none exists here; body size, coordinates and stock are never used). measure: value rounded to the resolution; uncertainty = placements x (calibration uncertainty + half the resolution), plus 1% of the length for a strand laid out by hand; below resolution or over range is a paid limit with no value. Units in place, partial or worked items get no reading. Moisture and rigidity are unavailable. construct-weather-shelter@1 rod checks are judged over the uncertainty (meets, fails, indeterminate); suitability stays undetermined unless a check fails. A reading covers that unit and goes stale when its record changes. Nothing is consumed, reserved or moved. No reward.

execution.progress: Atomic one-round steps; a pending transfer waits for an explicit paid verify or resume, never advances on its own and holds no lock.

details.costs: Study 2 rounds, 0.2 energy each. investigate: 1 round, 0.2 energy, one target in reach. transfer and verify: 1 round, 0.2 energy each; source is a serviceable item or object in reach with a complete verified length calibration record (none exists here); carrier is one separated whole, rigid, plain, sound wood unit, yours or loose in reach, no longer than the source range; light. No marking, cutting or expendables. resume runs the next step at its cost; cancel is free. Every check precedes payment: a refused request costs nothing. Travel, gathering and reading records are separate actions.
details.effects: investigate: a personal record and event of observed facts, unsupported claims and unknowns: calibration record status, and whether the piece is an uncalibrated comparison span (a non-metric record, never a calibration); conclusion "no qualifying standard established among these examined candidates" unless one qualifies. Nothing is consumed, reserved or moved. transfer: the carrier is laid end to end beside the source and read; calibration pending. verify: a second reading; if they agree, the carrier gets a reference-length record that examine-material reads: span = resolution = range, uncertainty = placements x (source uncertainty + resolution) + reading difference; no subdivisions or diameter. Any change of the carrier makes it stale; time never restores it. Without a source: refused, zero progress. No reward.

packet.access: Omission is not absence. Query abilities, own inventory, knowledge, projects, memory, state or personally observed objects in batches. Ability search/list returns compact catalogue entries; use exact ids for full interface details and applicability. Search results are indexes. Exact queries return one record per offset. All paged records use600-code-unit fragments with zero-based part0..parts-1, consistently in proactive and queried views. Current-scope retained queries are reprojected using these stable pages; original results remain archived. Queries expose no hidden properties, other private records or historical capabilities. Queries do not perform physical trials or award experience. Exact-id queries return a complete record of up to 6000 code units as one value in a single result; larger records keep the paged form. Paged records omit their per-record notes: concatenate all parts before parsing; continue with the same exact id. An entry marked inRetrieval is shown with at least the same content under the same id in this input's retrieval. observation.terrain rows are "y:x:cells" strings: each character of cells is the terrain kind of one visible cell, at x, x+1, ... in row y. abilities.baseline entries with id, function and args summarize interfaces you neither used in the last 25 rounds nor need now. args lists the arguments in order: a bare name is a string; otherwise its type with any bounds (number>=lo, integer<=hi, integer lo..hi, and a bare lo..hi is a number range) or its choices a|b; ? marks an optional argument and "" means none. An exact abilities query by id returns the complete contract, including references and string limits of 200 or more code units.

retrieval.access: Search/index only; omission is not absence. Use exact ids and zero-based offset/part for full records. No physical observation, state change or reward is performed.
